question: ‘Waiting for A Visa’ is a famous autobiography of ___________.
solution:
The correct answer is **__Dr. BR Ambedkar__.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

__
 
• Waiting for a Visa is a** 20-page autobiographical life story of Dr. B.R. Ambedkar.**
 
• It was written in the** period 1935-36.**
 
• It consists of reminiscences drawn by** ****Dr. B.R. Ambedkar.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

__
 
• **Swami Acchutanand__ was a poet, critic, dramatist, historian, social reformer, former Arya Samajist, **and **founder of the Adi Hindu** movement.​ 
 
• **__Babu Jagjivan Ram __**was an** Indian Independence activist and politician from Bihar.**
 
• __**MC Rajah**__ was an **Indian politician.**
